summary: Lolo National Forest lookout near Alberton, Mont.: 30-foot pole L-4 tower built 1933, destroyed 1964; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with a gabled L-4 cab
facts.status_note: destroyed in 1964 per firelookout.com; the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Montana list marks the tower as gone

staffing.status: one staffing mention, 1935; no later staffing source found

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says destroyed in 1964; montanalookouts.weebly.com lists the site only as removed, with no date. Both say the tower no longer stands, so status stays gone; the story reports both wordings.

sources.title: Montana Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Built and destroyed dates come from one page (firelookout.com). Two web searches found no second source; they returned only other lookouts, and Mineral Peak, a different lookout, was not used. The 1935 item is known only as quoted by montanalookouts.weebly.com; the Missoulian was not read. The source gives 30' without saying it is tower height, so height_m is omitted. No access or visit facts: no source describes them, so the brief's access 'unknown' stands. No photos added: firelookout.com credits a photo to the Fire Lookout Museum but gives no image URL.
